```python
def merge_intervals(intervals):
    if not intervals:
        return []
    
    # Sort intervals by start time
    intervals.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    
    # Initialize result with first interval
    merged = [intervals[0]]
    
    # Iterate through remaining intervals

        last = merged[-1]

            merged[-1] = (last[0], max(last[1], current[1]))

    return merged
```
